Dozens of near-identical steps hunting for shortcuts (zstd binaries, dlopen tests, tar --zstd, node, interpreters, static libs). The agent circles the same dead-end investigation for ~60 steps without ever recognizing the effort has stalled — the direct opposite of noticing circular debugging and re-diagnosing.

Declares completion after only spot-checking multi-frame/skippable via the wrapper; asserts 'handles all zstd features' by delegation rather than verifying individual required features. No coverage check against the spec's checklist.
